messages:
Priya: FYI customer ACME (tenant: acme-prod-2) escalated — AWS Marketplace invoice shows 1,200,000 token-units for 2026-03-08 but our internal usage for that marketplace account sums to ~1,100,120 tokens. Can eng/finops help reconcile? Invoice snapshot: https://console.aws.amazon.com/billing/home#/invoice/INV-12345 :thinking_face:

Jon: Can you paste the exact AWS line item JSON (customer_identifier / seller_sku)? Also, did ACME recently merge any subaccounts or request tenant consolidation? Typical cause = marketplace subaccount mapped to an old tenant id. Can you run a quick join query:```sql
select marketplace_customer_identifier, tenant_id, sum(tokens) as tokens
from marketplace_usage
where marketplace_account='aws:acct-aws-54321' and usage_date='2026-03-08'
group by 1,2;```

Priya: quick dump from AWS console (redacted) - clipped below:
```json
{"product_code":"AWSPROD-XYZ","usage_start":"2026-03-08T00:00:00Z","usage_quantity":"1200000","unit":"TokenUnits","customer_identifier":"acct-aws-54321:subacct-999","seller_sku":"redwood-token-std","invoice_id":"INV-12345"}
```
I ran the internal query already, results: marketplace shows 1,200,000 tokens. Our usage table shows
- acme-prod-2 => 1,100,120 tokens
- acme-prod-staging => 99,880 tokens
But ACME told Support they merged staging into prod on 2026-03-09. The invoice cutoff was 2026-03-08 so staging tokens are included under the marketplace account but after the merge the mapping should have been updated.

Lee: Do we have any credits/prorations on that invoice? I can see invoice INV-12345 has no credits applied on AWS side. If tokens belong to a different tenant mapping pre-merge we probably need to either request an AWS invoice adjustment or issue an internal customer credit.

aws-billing-bot: Found 1 unmatched marketplace_usage rows for acct-aws-54321 on 2026-03-08, id=mu-7782 (99,880 tokens).

Jon: Confirmed hypothesis — the subaccount (subacct-999) was still mapped to legacy tenant id acme-prod-legacy (tenant 8743) in our marketplace_customer_mapping table at invoice cutoff. After the merge (2026-03-09) we updated mapping to point to acme-prod-2 but that was after AWS generated the line items. So AWS correctly invoiced the raw subaccount usage, but our post-merge mapping caused the internal report to attribute those tokens to prod and staging differently.

Jon: Actionable items I propose:
1) Run a backfill classification for 2026-03-08 to mark marketplace_usage.mu-7782 as belonging to 'acme-prod-staging' pre-merge (so internal usage report matches AWS line item).
2) We cannot change the AWS invoice retroactively without going through AWS support — that takes time. Recommend issuing an internal billing correction / credit to ACME for 99,880 tokens (or offer a one-time credit equal to pro-rated USD).
3) Add a check to the marketplace onboarding flow to delay mapping flips until after invoice cutoff if customer requests immediate merge.

Priya: Customer-facing plan: open ticket to explain root cause (subaccount mapping timing), offer credit or apply to next invoice. Will wait on finops to confirm $ amount before committing.

Lee: Rough dollar impact @ our sticker: 99,880 tokens ~= $49.94 (using $0.0005/token). I'll queue a $49.94 credit pending sign-off.

BillingBot: Zendesk ticket #ZD-45678 created (ACME billing dispute).

Priya: Jon — can you run the backfill now and paste the job id? Customer wants resolution this week.

Jon: kicked off backfill job job-20260311-01. It will reclassify marketplace_usage rows for date 2026-03-08 and annotate them with pre-merge tenant mapping. ETA ~ 18 minutes. I also left a note in the mapping table explaining why we delayed automated mapping updates.

aws-billing-bot: job-20260311-01 completed — 1 row reclassified (mu-7782).

Priya: Confirmed internal reports now show 1,200,000 tokens billed on 2026-03-08 (prod 1,100,120 + staging 99,880) matching AWS invoice. Customer notified that we will apply a $49.94 credit unless they prefer AWS invoice adjustment.

Lee: I'll create the credit memo and apply it to ACME account. Also adding a follow-up to update onboarding checklist to include mapping freeze note.

Priya: Closing loop — customer accepted credit. Closing ticket after credit applied. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
